The Christmas flight is finished and paused. X spent **$941.60**, delivered **319,203 impressions**, and drove **176 link clicks** to https://kovireel.com/christmas.

There is no X pixel on the site, so trial starts are only in your signup records. The campaign optimized for link clicks on posts that ask people to start the 14-day trial.

|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Mon Nov 30 | $219.69 | 67,988 | 29 |
| Tue Dec 1 | $203.38 | 82,724 | 34 |
| Wed Dec 2 | $315.31 | 103,728 | 67 |
| Thu Dec 3 | $203.21 | 64,763 | 46 |
| **Total** | **$941.60** | **319,203** | **176** |

The double-feature post carried the flight: $633.42, 214,643 impressions, 129 link clicks. The December 24 deadline post added $245.08, 81,265 impressions, and 41 link clicks. The gift-invitation post and the soft “thanks for looking” post were not promoted. Ads ran to US adults 18+ with an anime interest, in English, from midnight Eastern on November 30 through the end of December 3.
